Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Avinash  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Narendra Kumar Singh  ======================================================
 CORAM:
ORAL ORDER 2 19-05-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State.

Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 498A/354B/30734 and other ancillary sections of the Indian Penal Code and sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
It is a case of torture and harassment for dowry.
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is bhaisur of the victim.
Allegation of torture and harassment is general and omnibus and no overt act has been alleged against him.
He is separate in mess and business.
Thrust of accusation is against husband of the victim who has already been allowed bail vide order passed in Cr.Mis.No. Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.20170 of 2023(2) dt.19-05-2023 17252/2023.
Considering the aforesaid facts of the case, prayer for bail of all the petitioner is allowed.

In the event of arrest/surrender within six weeks from today, let the petitioner, mentioned above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like Lalan Prasad Sah vs The State Of Bihar on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102252179/
1 amount each to the satisfaction of Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate Munger in Mahila Police Station Case No. 38 of 2021, subject to the conditions laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
